examples.zh: 詹妮在一个中国家庭暂住了两年。现在她习惯了在中国的生活。

content.v: be used to 是常考词组，所以学生一定要掌握以下固定搭配及用法：
1) sb. be used to 跟动名词或名词，表示“某人习惯做某事”。
2) sth. be used to 跟动词原形，表示“被用来做某事”(= sth. be used for doing sth.)。
3) sb. used to 跟动词原形，表示“某人过去习惯做某事”。

errata.original: Jenny stays with a Chinese family for two years. Now she’s used to the life in China.
errata.corrected: Jenny has stayed with a Chinese family for two years. Now she’s used to the life in China.
errata.note: for two years 不能与一般现在时 stays 连用，应为 has stayed；经人工复核（GitHub #135 第 127 条）确认更正
